title: Planned petroleum-sector security workers sit-in at Kuwait Petroleum Corporation, announced then suspended
reason: Al-Anba’s 6 January notice called for an 11 January sit-in by petroleum-sector security workers. A 9 January union notice says it suspended the planned sit-in after a meeting with Kuwait Petroleum Corporation management, before its scheduled date; the available record does not report an executed gathering. A future announcement or canceled action is not an actual mass mobilization.
notes: Exclude only this canceled announced action. The reports do not establish the intended participant headcount or whether the two union descriptions refer to exactly the same planned action; no crowd is coded.
